correctness.rationale: Funk–Hecke diagonalization yields ||T_theta|| on mean-zero L2 = sup_{l>=1}|P_l(cos theta)|. With a=(sqrt6-1)/5 and rho=(2+3sqrt6)/25, P2(a)=P3(a)=-rho; P2 for 0<=x<a, P3 for a<x<=rho and P1 for x>rho give strict global lower bound elsewhere. Exact P4(a), P5(a) are strictly smaller. Laplace integral gives |P_l(a)|<=B6=(2524-189sqrt6)/6250<rho for all l>=6 (not a finite inference). Reflection x↔-x and harmonic dimensions 5+7 give two angles and 12 worst-case directions; powers follow spectral theorem.
